description.zh:
OSS存储对象的唯一标识ID。

> 调用[DescribeOssObjects](~~410152~~)接口获取ID。
description.en:
The unique ID of the OSS storage object.

> Call the [DescribeOssObjects](~~410152~~) operation to obtain the ID.

description.zh:
设置请求和返回消息的语言类型。默认值为**zh_cn**。取值

- **zh_cn**：简体中文
- **en_us**：英文（美国）
description.en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh_cn**. Valid values:

- **zh_cn**: Simplified Chinese.
- **en_us**: English (US).

description.zh: 文件在OSS上存储的完整文件名。
description.en: The full name of the file stored in OSS.

description.zh: 服务地域ID，即Bucket所在的地域ID。
description.en: The service region ID, which is the region ID of the bucket.

description.zh:
行业模版ID。
> 您可以通过调用[DescribeCategoryTemplateList](~~2399296~~)获取行业模板标识ID。
description.en:
The industry template ID.
> Call the [DescribeCategoryTemplateList](~~2399296~~) operation to obtain the industry template ID.

title.zh: 查询OSS存储对象的详细信息V2
title.en: Query details of an OSS storage object V2

descriptions.zh: 本接口一般用于对OSS存储对象详细信息的查询，便于对OSS敏感资产信息准确定位。
descriptions.en: This operation is used to query the details of an OSS storage object, which helps you accurately locate sensitive asset information in OSS.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sddp describe-oss-object-detail-v2 --lang zh_cn --id 12300 --service-region-id cn-hangzhou --bucket-name sddp-api-scan-demo --object-key dir1/test.png --template-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
